integrity: Complete elementary proof and independent finite checker are supplied; finite computations are not treated as proof for unbounded n. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to additive two-generator semigroups with consecutive generators, not arbitrary coprime generators.
Descent positions alone do not imply new exact minimum distances for any particular algebraic-geometric code.
Accessible-priority comparison does not exclude unindexed Hermitian-code computations with implicit equivalent coverage.
title: Triangular descent spectrum of Feng–Rao multiplicities for consecutive-generator semigroups
